content.introduction: The S&P 500 is nearing the final wave of its current rally, with bear market risks increasing. Analysts predict the current bull market will last another 70-100 years. This long-term trend contrasts with past 60-year bear markets.
body: This long-term 3rd wave is what has fostered the bullish mantras of “buy the dip,” “do not time the market,” “always be invested,” and “the market always comes back.”  And, this long-term bull market has done its job of convincing the masses that this cycle will not end and will continue unabated. You see, it was during that period of time that investors were entangled within a 60-year bear market, when the mantra was only “sell the rips.” As an aside, I do not see a bear market that long as being in our future until we complete the 5-wave Grand Supercycle in approximately 70-100 years. (For those that are questioning how I could presume that the next 50+ year bear market will not likely begin for another 70-100 years, I will tell you that Ralph Nelson Elliott himself (the progenitor of Elliott Wave analysis) used this same analysis to call for a 70+ year bull market in 1941).
